title: Crawler size threshold replicates on seed 3: R=8 stops by t~80, R=10 by ~160, R=12 keeps 0.79; stronger myosin keeps R=8 at 0.95
summary: The author's speed probe re-run with the founder seeded by seed 3 (probe/speed.py takes the seed as an argument; probe/crawler.py is the positive-control world). Speeds per 20 t: R=8: 0.78, 0.52, 0.24, 0.02, then 0; R=10: 0.87 ... 0.26, 0.01, 0 (stops at t~160); R=12: 0.91 then a steady 0.79; R=8 with sigma=1.3, alpha=4: steady 0.95. labkit run of R0=10 on seed 3 (rerun_R10/sheet.png): an elongated crawler with a polarization streak that rounds up and stops by t~150 (4.7 BL).

observations.F: probe/speeds_s3.txt; rerun_R10/sheet.png t=0-200 (crawl, then round and static)

controls_run.F: probe/speeds_s3.txt: R=8, 10, 12 and R=8 with sigma 1.3, alpha 4 on the same seed

verdicts.limitation: The world is deterministic apart from the founder's position and kick, so a new seed is a weak replication: the speed series are nearly identical to the author's. Thresholds measured at t=200 only and at one grid; R=12 not followed beyond t=200 by me.
